data.name: Samgood Chronicles DragonFall
data.detailed_description:
The world won't tell you everything.

Some places won't tell you anything.
Nobody agrees on the details.

Nobody wants to talk about it.

And everyone is doing their very best to ignore the dragons...

...because nobody wants another Great Scorching.

But clues are scattered throughout dungeons, castles, taverns, and forgotten corners of Samgood.

Your job?

Find out what's really happening.

Preferably without dying.

Build Your Party

Create and name a party of four heroes, choosing from seven unique classes—each with their own abilities, strengths, and wonderfully terrible ideas.

Paladin – Battle Cry, Battle Chant, Berserker

Rogue – Shadow Ledger, poison, stealth strikes, cutpurse tricks

Mage – Fireball, Earthquake, Frost, Life Drain, Revive

Healer – Healing with science, revival, stimulants

Archer – Bullseye, Flaming Arrows, Rope Arrows

Siren – Charm Song, Confusion Song, Siren Thrall

Werewolf – Moon Howl, Savage Bite, Frenzy

Every class is powerful.

Every class is unpredictable.

Every class is capable of making your life significantly worse if used at exactly the wrong moment.

Features

Handcrafted retro pixel‑art fantasy RPG

Inspired by classic dungeon crawlers of the 1980s

Create and name your own party of four heroes

Seven unique playable classes

Tactical turn‑based combat

Three kingdoms to explore

Three dragon boss quests

Over 40 handcrafted locations

15+ ally encounters

24 random enemies waiting for your soul

12 unique chest and urn traps

Eleven‑for‑Heaven dice gambling

Level‑scaled shops

Fully usable world map

Three save slots

Approximately 3–6 hours of adventure, with additional replay value

Handcrafted by a single developer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3‑2100 or AMD FX‑4100
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows‑compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most modern and older PCs, laptops, and Steam Deck via Proton
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GT 1030
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows‑compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on modern laptops, desktops, and Steam Deck via Proton.
